sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by anti-HA immunolabelling of living Flp-in HEK cells under non-permeabilising conditions (L4, L5, PMC4806671). Functional signalling assays were performed with HA11-tagged GPR18 in HEK293 cells (L6, L7, PMC2865488) but the clips do not report the quantitative outcome of those assays; receptor-level function relative to untagged GPR18 is NOT MEASURED in the ledger clips.
sites.rationale: GPR18 is a class-A GPCR with no signal peptide; the computed topology places residues 1–22 extracellular and TM1 beginning at residue 23, leaving exactly one extracellular terminus. All seven ledger lines describe N-terminal HA or HA11 tags on full-length, membrane-anchored GPR18 without naming a residue, so the junction is uniquely determined as a prepend before M1 (insert_after_residue = 0). The 22-residue extracellular N-terminal stretch provides ample distance (>3 aa) from the TM1 boundary. L4 and L5 directly confirm that the HA-tagged receptor reaches the cell surface in living cells under non-permeabilising conditions, establishing surface_only validation. Multiple independent groups expressed full-length human GPR18 with N-terminal HA (PMC4806671, L2–L5) or HA11 (PMC2865488, L6–L7) tags in HEK293/Flp-in HEK cells. L4 and L5 (PMC4806671) confirmed surface display of HA-hGPR18 by anti-HA immunolabelling of living cells under non-permeabilising conditions. L3 (PMC4806671) used a 3×HA variant with an exogenous bovine pre-prolactin signal sequence (pplss-3HA-hGPR18); after pplss cleavage the 3×HA tag is at the same N-terminal junction. L1 (PMC4451551) provides indirect corroboration via the murine ortholog. No ledger line names a residue number; the N-terminus (residues 1–22, no signal peptide) is the sole extracellular terminus, so the junction is topology-derived as a prepend before M1.

sources.claim: Anti-HA labelling of Flp-in HEK cells stably expressing HA-hGPR18 (A, B, C) or HA-TCS-hCB1 (D, E, F).

literature_notes: All seven ledger lines (L1–L7) converge on a single N-terminal prepend junction. L1 is indirect (murine GPR18 ortholog); L2–L7 are direct (human GPR18). L3 describes a distinct construct (pplss-3HA-hGPR18) that lands at the same junction after exogenous signal cleavage and is therefore not a separate site. No ledger line supports any insertion in ECL1 (80–91), ECL2 (160–182), ECL3 (258–268), or any intracellular loop; those loops are not proposed. The C-terminus (residues 290–331) is intracellular and has no ledger support for a surface tag.
